title: The pace knob itself still loads via lenient jint — missing key silently reverts to the stale pace 30, decimals silently truncate
detail: The diff's central knob bypasses the fail-fast bar it applies to the two adjacent new keys: a balance.json missing packet_bandwidth (or carrying a decimal) silently loads the stale pace 30 instead of aborting — masking a partial or tampered catalog.
recommended_fix: Route packet_bandwidth through jint_strict with a -1 default plus a >=1 presence check, matching terminal_spawn_interval_ticks; drop the silent 30 fallback (or refresh it to the shipped 120).

title: New catalog interval feeds a modulo with no use-site zero guard, unlike the placement block's documented in-code-literal defense
detail: placement_valid floors its catalog separation at the use site for Balance{} literals that omit the block; the new interval has no such floor — a zero interval is an integer divide-by-zero crash at the first growth tick. Unreachable via the loader today.
recommended_fix: Mirror the topology.odin:342 convention at the use site: interval := max(u64(1), cat.balance.terminal_spawn_interval_ticks) before the modulo, or early-return when the field is 0.
